viator_experiences.title: Private Cardiff Food and Drink Safari including Water Bus Ride to Cardiff Bay
viator_experiences.summary: This five-hour private gourmet tasting tour offers an authentic taste of Wales, with guests sampling delicacies such as laverbread alongside artisan foods…
viator_experiences.description_md: This five-hour private gourmet tasting tour offers an authentic taste of Wales, with guests sampling delicacies such as laverbread alongside artisan foods and locally brewed beers. The experience begins with cocktails and canapés, followed by a three-course lunch at a local restaurant. Guests then travel by water-bus to Cardiff Bay for cheese tasting and dessert at the iconic Wales Millennium Centre. Throughout the day a local guide shares insider knowledge of Cardiff's eclectic food scene as you visit cafés, artisan shops and markets. This is a private tour, ensuring personalised attention from your guide.

viator_experiences.title: Gin Tour at Hensol Castle Distillery
viator_experiences.summary: Housed in a 17th-century castle, this tour at Hensol Castle Distillery offers a thorough overview of the building's history and its spirits-loving former…
viator_experiences.description_md: Housed in a 17th-century castle, this tour at Hensol Castle Distillery offers a thorough overview of the building's history and its spirits-loving former owners. Visitors learn about the modernised distillery process and discover the role of botanicals in producing some of the United Kingdom's finest gins. The sensory experience features over 50 unique botanicals and explains how gin became one of the world's most popular spirits. The tour concludes with a welcome drink, a tutored tasting of three gins and a complimentary gin and tonic of your choice in the bar. Recommended by 97% of travellers, it is a small-group experience praised for its knowledgeable hosts.
